chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام said: I heard the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say: “Leniency is a means of profit.”
He عليه السلام said: “That applies to a man who is being advised while he has merchandise that he is selling.”

key_terms.السَّمَاحُ: leniency, ease, and generous conduct in dealings
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.سِلْعَةٌ: merchandise or goods offered for sale

ai.seo_question: How does leniency in trade lead to profit according to a hadith from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that gentleness and ease in dealing with others are a cause of gain. In the context of trade, it points to the virtue of forbearance and accommodating conduct with customers and advisers.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3735 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
I heard the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) say, "Leniency is a means of profit."
Imam (as) then said: "This applies to a man who is advised while he has goods to sell."
